headlines.title: Trump answers questions from reporters after Republican midterm losses
headlines.description: President Trump took questions from reporters on the midterm results, the future of Republican leadership, the war with Iran and the possibility of impeachment in his first appearance since election night.

headlines.title: Vance says the ‘real reason’ for GOP rout was anger over Iran war
headlines.description: Hours after Democrats routed Republicans in the midterm elections, Vice President JD Vance blamed his party’s losses on Americans’ frustration over the U.S. war with Iran, which has driven up oil prices at a time when costs are already high.

headlines.title: House Speaker Mike Johnson will not stay on as Republican leader after GOP losses
headlines.description: A day after Democrats won the House majority, Speaker Mike Johnson, R-La., told his staff in a phone call this morning he will not not stay on as Republican leader in the new Congress, according to four sources on the call.

headlines.title: Stocks surge as ‘blue tsunami’ puts political uncertainty to rest
headlines.description: Stocks had their best day in months. Shares of Elon Musk’s SpaceX and Tesla declined, however, after the billionaire spent heavily to support Republicans.

headlines.title: 5 key insights from the NBC News Exit Poll about the blue tsunami
headlines.description: Voters expressed feeling fed up with the economy; Democratic candidates emerged more well-liked and Trump was resoundingly rejected.
headlines.source: Patrick J. Egan, NBC News Exit Poll Desk

headlines.title: Progressive William Lawrence defeats GOP Rep. Tom Barrett in swing Michigan district
headlines.description: NBC News projects that Lawrence has unseated Barrett, who was running for a second term, in a district Trump carried in 2024.

headlines.title: Democrats gain full control of five state governments, further expanding the party’s power
headlines.description: Democrats gained total control of at least five state governments on Tuesday, giving the party a level of power it hasn’t held in some of those places in years.

headlines.title: Democrats score key secretary of state wins ahead of the 2028 election
headlines.description: Democrats won secretary of state contests in four presidential battlegrounds while making inroads in red territory, giving them election oversight authority in key states for the 2028 elections.

headlines.title: Tuesday’s elections bring historic first for Black governors
headlines.description: Wins by Byron Donalds in Florida, Keisha Lance Bottoms in Georgia and Wes Moore in Maryland mean multiple Black governors will serve simultaneously for the first time.

headlines.title: Troy Jackson defeats GOP Sen. Susan Collins in Maine, padding Democrats’ majority
headlines.description: NBC News projects that Jackson, who became the Democratic nominee after an embattled Graham Platner dropped out, flipped control of the Senate seat.

headlines.title: Record number of female governors elected
headlines.description: Voters in 15 states have elected female governors, setting a record as Democrats made sweeping gains in races up and down the ballot.

headlines.title: Democrat James Talarico turns Texas Senate seat blue, defeating Ken Paxton
headlines.description: Talarico has made history in Texas, notching a Democratic Senate victory there for the first time since 1988, NBC News projects.
